subject: Veridian security packet initiation — HIPAA scope & SIG vs custom form
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-08T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Veridian security packet initiation — HIPAA scope & SIG vs custom form

Hi Sara — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a few clarifying questions so we can kick off the security packet efficiently.

Call highlights:
- Product in scope: CareSync (integration with EHRs) — looks like this is the only product that may touch PHI.
- Primary asks from your team: SOC 2 status, encryption at rest/in transit, data residency, and vendor evidence for access controls.

Clarifying questions (so we send the right form):
1) Is Veridian asking us to complete SIG-Lite, CAIQ, or a short custom questionnaire? You mentioned a preference for a succinct form on the call — can you confirm?
2) HIPAA scope: you indicated CareSync stores identifiers for scheduling; can you confirm whether Veridian requires us to attest to Business Associate Agreement (BAA) coverage now, or only at contract stage?
3) Evidence delivery: do you want scanned PDFs via email, a secure upload to your SFTP, or a link to a shared Drive?

Proposed next steps:
- I can send a SIG-Lite + a one-page custom questionnaire tailored to CareSync risk areas.
- If you prefer CAIQ instead, we can do that but it will take slightly longer.
- If you confirm HIPAA/BAA applicability, we’ll escalate to legal for the DPA/DPA addendum; I’ve attached our SIG starter guide to illustrate the level of detail we typically share.

Attachments: redwood-sig-starter.pdf (1 page starter, attachment stub)

If you can confirm answers to Q1–Q3, we’ll route to Karthik for technical clarifications and Neha for timelines and DPA prep.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz

Date: 2026-07-09T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Veridian security packet initiation — HIPAA scope & SIG vs custom form

Hi Vanessa — thanks for the tidy summary. Answers below.

1) Form preference: We prefer a short custom questionnaire (we'll attach a 10–12 question vendor sheet) — SIG-Lite is acceptable as a secondary option. CAIQ is more than we need for this purchase.

2) HIPAA / BAA: HIPAA applies only to the CareSync product and only where Veridian is acting as a covered entity ingesting patient identifiers. We need a BAA for CareSync integrations prior to production data exchange; we do not require a BAA for evaluation or demo environments that use synthetic data.

3) Evidence delivery: Please upload evidence to our secure intake portal (upload link below) when possible — we can accept PDFs. If that's not possible, email is OK for initial items.

Portal (preferred): https://security.veridianhealth.com/vendor-upload/VER-4721
Attached: Veridian_SOC2_Summary_2025.pdf (attestation summary, redacted)

A couple of additional notes for your team:
- Encryption: in-transit TLS 1.2+, at-rest AES-256 is required.
- Key management: we prefer KMS with separate keys per customer if applicable; otherwise detail your key rotation policy.

CC'ing our security mailbox so they see the open items: security@veridianhealth.com

Thanks,
Sara Lin
Director, Product Operations | Veridian Health
sara.lin@veridianhealth.com

Sara / Vanessa — quick technical clarifications from our side so we can pre-fill the custom questionnaire correctly.

1) PHI flow: For CareSync integrations, does Veridian POST patient-identifying data directly to a Redwood ingestion endpoint, or do you route to an intermediary (e.g., integration bus) that then forwards to Redwood? The distinction affects our recommended controls and whether we need per-customer key separation.

2) Data retention: If PHI is in scope, what is your expected retention window for data returned from Redwood? Will Veridian request token-level logs or raw payloads for troubleshooting?

3) Analytics: Does Veridian expect Redwood to process data with downstream analytics services (e.g., third-party telemetry) that could access PHI? If so we need to list those processors and include subprocessors in the SIG answers.

If you can reply inline, we’ll draft short, targeted answers for the custom sheet and attach an evidence bundle. Happy to hop on a 15-min follow-up call if easier.

Thanks — Karthik

4) Timeline: we aim to return completed questionnaire + SOC2 artifacts within 10 business days of receiving the custom sheet. If Veridian wants CAIQ instead, add 3–5 business days.
